title: Upload queue
description: Make parallel file progress and cancellation readable in a small space.
useCase: Make parallel file progress and cancellation readable in a small space.
interaction: Start, cancel, or retry an upload
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Explicit simulated upload preview; no files or data leave the browser. Host pause stops the timer; reduced motion keeps values updating without tweening.
look: White rounded card on a pale blue-grey page listing three files with pastel file-type tiles, thin sage progress bars, small percentages and remove crosses.
motion: Pressing preview ticks every 400 ms, advancing each file at its own rate; each bar's fill scales horizontally with a 400 ms linear transition, and finished rows show a check.
adapt: Simulated progress is the `setInterval` effect gated by `play` (`400` ms ticks, step `4 + i * 2`); each bar is a `scaleX` on `.progress i` with `transition: transform 400ms linear`. Replace `names` and the timer with real upload progress.
